physicalNotes: No radius or mass of M43 is recorded: it is an extended nebula, and its package frames it at 0.42 pc (object.json worldFrame.bodyRadiusM), half its picture's short side, a presentation value.

sources.position: SIMBAD, M 43 (through the Nebula Lab's Messier inventory)
sources.distance: Menten et al. (2007), The distance to the Orion Nebula, A&A 474, 515: 414 ± 7 pc from radio parallaxes of four stars in the Orion Nebula Cluster; M43 is part of the same nebula complex, so it takes the Orion Nebula's distance (https://arxiv.org/abs/0709.0485)
sources.properMotion: Zero: the nebula is held at its catalogued position; no motion across the sky is applied.
sources.radialVelocity: Zero: no radial velocity is recorded for the nebula here.
